wrongUnits.problem: Says any active POA without an agent/agency ID, or any waiting POA without an appendix type, fails the data flow.
wrongUnits.correct: Is Renewal only sees rows that the lookup matched, so a NULL agentcyIdNumberPa fails the flow only when that active POA shares account/program with a due waiting POA. AppendixType only sees Not-Renewal rows (after Update NeedToSendMailBit), so a waiting POA with NULL gen_appendixtype fails the flow only when it matched an active POA of a different agent. A waiting POA with NULL appendix type and no active match goes to Union All -> No Email without error.

Gen_startdate and Gen_enddate (written to StartDate/EndDate) are dateadd(HH,3,...) in both source queries, a fixed offset. The selection filters use the unshifted values.
